summary: R241 adds a fail-closed device/generation-owned translation-slot boundary on top of R240 programmable shader-pair cache readiness. A slot can be reserved only from an exact current R240 cache snapshot; duplicate reservation is idempotent, collision/incomplete/stale snapshots are rejected, and device reinitialization requires a distinct fresh slot. No D3D11 programmable shader objects are created or bound and NativeDrawPath stays dormant.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered GitHub DX11 lane at 1edba4aaded69692246a63daecdd9561e7367917; read current HEAD, review index/Set05, AGENTS.md, queue contract, CONVERSION_LANE_STATE.json, VR_DX11_NATIVE_PLAN.md, automation/run/review state, regression knowledge/problem history and Issue #14. R240 is complete and its durable next action explicitly selects a fail-closed translation/object-slot ownership boundary. Current dispatch is rollover and does not increment ATTEMPT.

C1_REVIEW.finding: R240 authenticates and owns programmable pair cache identity per D3D11 device, but there is no explicit ownership slot separating 'pair cached' from 'translation object may exist'. Without that boundary a future translator could accidentally treat cache presence as translated-object readiness.

review_lenses.architecture: Extend the dormant R240 owner rather than adding a runtime caller or translator.
review_lenses.ownership_lifetime: Bind each reserved slot to the cache owner/device generation and current exact cache snapshot; clear slots with cache entries on device reinitialize.
review_lenses.performance: No production hot-path caller; metadata-only unordered-map entry field plus probe operations.
review_lenses.adversarial: Reject collision/incomplete/stale cache snapshots, prove no implicit translation object presence, duplicate reservation idempotence, and fresh slot generation after device recreation.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Added NativeProgrammableShaderTranslationSlotReadiness plus reserve/readiness/snapshot APIs to the R240 per-device owner, per-entry slot generation metadata and monotonic owner-local slot generation counter; extended WARP constant-buffer probe and source-graph guards for unreserved, exact, duplicate, collision, incomplete, stale-snapshot and device-generation cases.

C3_VALIDATE.evidence: Backend Conversion Gate must validate the exact material SHA, including Win32 build and readiness smoke constant-buffer probe. No Quest 3/VDXR runtime test performed.

C5_PACKAGE.reason: Dormant metadata ownership/readiness boundary only; no translated shader objects, runtime draw path or distributable runtime behavior is promoted.

C6_STATE.exact_next_action: Publish R241 material result without CI skip, require exact-SHA Backend Conversion Gate, then persist final run/lane state while keeping RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED and NativeDrawPath dormant.

regression_assessment.evidence: Dormant native_backend metadata ownership plus hosted probe only; no D3D9 hook, stereo renderer, transport, OpenXR submission or production NativeDrawPath caller changes.

exact_next_action: Publish R241 as the validation-bearing material result, validate its exact SHA, then finalize C3/C4/C6 without conflating automated validation with HMD runtime proof.
